messages:
Nina (PM): Support ticket: customers confused by the "Encrypted (KMS)" badge + region dropdown ordering in Workspace Settings. They think selecting a region changes which key is used. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/ux/kms-badge-confuse.png

Ravi (Design): I see it. Badge sits left of title and the region dropdown appears visually above KMS controls. Feels like region -> key mapping.

Maya (Security): Two quick points: 1) Do NOT show full key IDs in the UI/audit logs by default. 2) Use the KMS alias or a friendly name + truncated id if necessary.

Ida (A11y): Also observed: the badge has no keyboard focus in compact header and the label color in light theme is ~3.6:1 contrast. Needs AA.

Ravi (Design): Proposal: change badge text to "Encryption: Customer key" with a shield icon, move region into a separate "Storage region" subheading, and show KMS line as "KMS: alias/my-key (•••0f3a)". Visual order: badge/title, KMS toggle + alias, then storage region. DOM order: keep toggle first for screen readers.

Nina (PM): Recommended help copy: "Choosing a customer key encrypts data at rest. Retention and region residency are configured separately below." Can we add an explicit audit log note: "Key alias shown; key id redacted for safety"?

prod-bot: Draft UI copy:

Encryption: Customer key  [shield icon]
KMS: alias/my-company-key  (redacted-0f3a)
Help: Choosing a customer key encrypts workspace data at rest. This does not change retention or region settings.

Ida (A11y): For aria: add `role=status` and `aria-live=polite` on badge changes, `aria-label="Customer-managed key toggle"` on the toggle, and ensure keyboard focus order is toggle -> help -> region. I'll validate with VoiceOver once mock is up.

Maya (Security): Agree on alias display and audit copy. I'll update the audit docs to enforce redaction.

Ravi (Design): I'll update mocks for dark/light, bump label contrast to 4.5:1 and add a 3px focus ring for keyboard.

Nina (PM): I'll file a P2 ticket with ACs: alias display, audit redaction note, badge wording, contrast and focus, aria changes, DOM order tweak. Please include before/after screenshots.

Nina (PM): Filed: https://linear.app/RW/issue/UX-5055 "Clarify encryption badge & KMS alias" assigned to Ravi.

Ravi (Design): Linking mock later today.

Ida (A11y): I'll run an accessibility pass after the mock is posted.

Nina (PM): Thanks all :raised_hands:
